routing: The bodies (b) names and (c) counts are the keypoint lane's boxes; the anchor of (c) is the YOLO11m lane's sacrum box; YOLO11m's vertebra boxes go to neither. This is how the illustrated coupled numbers were produced (COUPLING.md det74; coupling.sh --sacrum-detector, no --box-detector). YOLO11m's vertebra class is drawn because the network has it and the held-out detection numbers of the Results score it.

scope_note: Panel (a) draws the detectors of the reported C-ArmLSpine system as the Methods ('The network') and the atlas card state them: neither trained on the test C-arm. SchwingNet/LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md section 15 (added 2026-09-24, commit d0403de) makes the Figure 6 PRIMARY detector one trained on the G3 TRAIN side of every device (the device seen), the device-held-out detectors a secondary, and leaves open whether the keypoint body detector is kept. The Methods now say so in the LevelCheck paragraph ('the primary detector was changed by commit before unblinding to one trained on the split's training persons of every device'), which concerns Figure 6 and Table 3; the paragraph Figure 3 draws ('The network') is unchanged. If that detector replaces the drawn ones for the naming results, panel (a)'s title and the YOLO11m lane label must follow; check_sources() stops the build on the changed quotes.
wording_note: the YOLO11m lane label is REVIEW2_RSNA.md Fix 26's replacement text ('YOLO11m box detector, render-trained, fine-tuned on real frames of two other devices') less 'box detector,', which put the line 0.27 in off the page at 12 pt; the lane's output icon, its 'boxes' label and the class key carry what it emits. The YOLO11m class is drawn as 'vertebra', as the atlas (classes vertebra and sacrum) and the Methods (vertebra and sacrum) name it; the figure brief's 'vertebral body' is not used because the atlas Limitations state the boxes are whole-vertebra projections with the vertebral-body recompute pending (G5). The keypoint lane's box is 'body', the Methods' word ('boxes the bodies the level model names').

colour.red: the transitional levels T13 and L6

caption: SchwingNet; shaded blocks learned, sizes in pixels. (a) Two detectors, neither naming a level; one boxes bodies, one the sacrum. (b) Level model: two-channel crop per body, ResNet-18, bidirectional gated recurrent unit (GRU) across bodies, 27-level posterior; red, T13 (thirteenth thoracic) and L6 (sixth lumbar). (c) Ordinals counted from the detected sacrum. (d) Posteriors choose the alphabet; outlined, the call.
